intent: The build should accurately deliver a portable CAD plus simulation-ready stair-climbing prototype model, not merely a bundle of files.
truths_enforced: Mobility chassis follows stair angle instead of staying flat.
Occupant pod has independent pitch-leveling joint.
The architecture uses exactly four main wheels with no crawler tracks, no belts, and no added helper wheels.
Wheel-only stair climbing traction is not claimed as the stair-climb mechanism.
The combined wheel-drive, independent-corner-actuator, pitched-chassis, pod-leveling system must pass the ramp-like stair-climb screen.
Local wheel/suspension command loops must target sub-millisecond update timing; preview sensors feed prediction and must not create wait-at-edge behavior.
Simulation model is simplified for dynamics but derived from detailed CAD geometry.
